template_data.headline_html: Five myths that keep small businesses waiting.

items.title: No past performance
items.sub: Commercial revenue qualifies — GSA doesn't require a government contract on record.

items.title: Approval = flowing contracts
items.sub: The Schedule is the door. Sales still require your pipeline and outreach.

items.title: We're too small
items.sub: MAS set-asides are designed specifically for small businesses.

items.title: It takes years
items.sub: Typical timeline: 6–12 months. Delays come from the application, not GSA.

items.title: SAM = GSA Schedule
items.sub: SAM is the vendor database. The Schedule is a separate contract vehicle.
